### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **7** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1e4656d01fe485935c493a00ecdb8e0f8a0fed55` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `370e21ad47acc78d567d7f070cfe02e7e7647452` — the merge of head `18b604942f7eb7d7c6c297ec09078a94d1f6325a` into base `1e4656d01fe485935c493a00ecdb8e0f8a0fed55`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 370e21ad47acc78d567d7f070cfe02e7e7647452 && git checkout 370e21ad47acc78d567d7f070cfe02e7e7647452
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1e4656d01fe485935c493a00ecdb8e0f8a0fed55 18b604942f7eb7d7c6c297ec09078a94d1f6325a && git checkout -B drift-repro 1e4656d01fe485935c493a00ecdb8e0f8a0fed55 && git merge --no-ff 18b604942f7eb7d7c6c297ec09078a94d1f6325a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1e4656d01fe485935c493a00ecdb8e0f8a0fed55
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 1e4656d01fe485935c493a00ecdb8e0f8a0fed55` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

**L1 first review · ACCEPT** · head `18b604942f7eb7d7c6c297ec09078a94d1f6325a` · card #34432 · read 2026-11-17T02:13Z

### Checklist (read on GitHub at this head, not from the report)

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`, the attribution comment and "Requested by" line open the body, then `Fixes #34432`. Closing-keyword scan of the whole body: one hit, `#34432`; `#34428`, `#34407`, `#34574` carry no keyword. `Fixes` is right: the card's three Target boxes (declared status and code, undeclared throw rethrown, route pins with a real 503 control) are all in the diff.
- **Head provenance:** `18b60494` = `d05e8d13` + a merge of `main`; all 3 PR files have the same blob at both commits.
- **File surface:** 3 files from `get_files`, exactly claim 6934080915: `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (`evaluateDeclaredRenames` and the 2b reader, shared), one card-named test file, the changeset.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` in the body and the changeset. Both hold: the input is refused before and after, only the status and code of the answer change, and no authorable key moves.
- **Mechanism, read in the source:**
  - `declaredRefusalAnswer` is the 2b catch body moved out unchanged: the same predicate (`declaredStatus === undefined || status >= 500` ⇒ `undefined` ⇒ rethrow), the same `code`, the same sentence. 2b now calls it, so its answer is byte-identical.
  - `evaluateDeclaredRenames` runs `packageUpgradeSideOf(converted)`, and `packageUpgradeSideOf(installed)` when there is an installed side, before `planDeclaredRenames`. Those are the same fold calls the plan makes (`marketplace-install-rename-planner.ts:81`), so a body the resolver refuses never reaches the plan's `catch`, and the 503 below is left with the table read and the plan's own faults (the body says so).
  - The caller at `:3248` passes `refusal.status` through; widening the return type from `422 | 503` to `number` is the only signature move.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34432-install-local-resolver-refusal.md`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection` patch (published). Sentences checked: "resolves the bodies before it reads any table" (the pre-fold sits before `planDeclaredRenames`); "`422 INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES` or `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY`, with the resolver's sentence. Nothing is written" (pinned); "the answer the `isolated`-posture unique-scope gate already gives … through the same reader" (shared function); "a dependency cycle … is rethrown" (pinned); "A runtime that carries them resolves the packages earlier, so its answer does not change" (step 1c: `collectJobsWithoutBody` / `collectHooksWithoutBody` are optional and feature-tested at `:7139`–`:7146`, so the older-runtime path is a coded path, not a test artefact).
- **Rejection assertions:** both 422 pins assert `status` and `error.code`, and nothing written (no `register`, no ledger entry, the driver's `planDeclaredRenames` and `carryDeclaredRenames` never called). The 503 control asserts `status` and `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, and that the driver was asked once.
- **Controls and ablation:** a 503 control on an unreadable table, a 200 control on a readable one, and the cycle pin. The ablation removes `packageUpgradeSideOf(converted)`: both 422 pins and the cycle pin go red with the card's 503 sentence, both controls stay green, and the blob is restored to HEAD's.
- **Deviations, accepted as reported:**
  - **Reach:** on a current runtime step 1c resolves first, and the refusal leaves the handler as a throw that the Hono seam answers 422. That was measured to the throw and read from `adapter.ts` for the 422. The changeset does not claim the transport's answer.
  - **Read superset:** a fresh install now also folds `data`, so a body refused only through `data` is refused here before any write instead of at register, on the same bytes and with the same code.
- **Gates at this head:** check-runs on `18b60494…`: 55 runs, 37 `success`, 18 `skipped`, 0 failed; `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check Changeset` and Test Core 1–8 `success`. Derived-gate round 71/71. Final head announced in 6935802086.

### Out of scope, for the area to place (one line each: `filed #N` or `dropped — reason`)

- The installed-side arm (`packageUpgradeSideOf(installed)` in the new pre-fold) has no pin and no ablation. A refusal there names the stored copy's fault but reads "Package 'X' cannot be installed", as if the incoming bytes were at fault. Before this PR the same case answered 503 at 2c″, and 2c′ folds the installed side again without a guard, so this PR adds no new dead end. Reachable only if a body the resolver accepted at install is refused now, for example by a shape retired since and not converted forward.
- The cycle's opaque 500 is already `filed #34574`.

### Owed after this

- **L2:** not owed. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, no `(narrowing)`, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path.
- **Landing tier:** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34573`: 0 of 3 paths governed, 326 changed lines (+313 / −13) ≤ 3000 ⇒ ordinary queue landing by the area, on this head. Serial note from the claim: #34431 (same file) waits for this PR.
